第二天一早，吴姜和李月芽一起，开着车，根据导航上搜索到带有锦绣二字的小区，一个个的找了过去。

还好的是，整个绿城，带有这两个字的小区，只有三个，吴姜选了最近的一个开了过去。

现在是白天，小丫头不能出来，吴姜让念念透过吊坠看了看，不是这里。

还剩两个，一个锦绣花园小区，是一个普通的小区。还有一个，锦绣天玺，是一个别墅区。

吴姜又仔细问了一下念念，她家里小区的环境怎么样，有没有什么特别的地方。

念念的声音透过聚灵吊坠，传入了吴姜的耳中，“我家里很大的，外面的树很多，花也很多，水里还有很多的鱼，还有还有，我家不用坐电梯，一进门就到家了！”

说到这里，吴姜立马明白了，这不就是别墅吗？小丫头要是早这么说，他就直奔锦绣天玺了。

设置了一下导航，车子立刻飞驰而去。

锦绣天玺的安保很严格，吴姜下车登记之后，保安又给业主打了一个电话，这才放行。

此刻，阮柏云和秦汐正在别墅门前等着，他们很好奇，是什么人来拜访他们，能准确的叫出他们的名字。

秦汐的眼睛还有些红肿，可见是家里出了变故导致的。

吴姜的车子很快开到了九号别墅前面，一眼就看到了等候在那里的一对夫妇，看年纪应该三十多岁，不到四十的样子。

吴姜和李月芽快步走上前，对着两人，礼貌地问道：“你们好，请问一下，你们就是阮柏云先生和秦汐女士吗？”

“你们是谁？”阮柏云皱着眉头，反问道。

吴姜此刻已经听到念念的喊“爸爸妈妈”的声音了。

吴姜开门见山：“阮先生，秦女士，你们好，我们是为了念念来的。”

听到“念念”两个字，阮柏云和秦汐的身体猛地一僵，秦汐的眼泪差点没忍住又落下来。

阮柏云很警惕，开口问道：“你们是什么人？和念念有什么关系？”

吴姜做了一个自我介绍，又将李月芽介绍给了对方，这才说道：“阮先生，这里不太方便详聊，不知道能不能进去，我再和你们解释。”

阮柏云犹豫了一下，又看了一下妻子，这才说道：“请进来吧！”

也没让吴姜和李月芽也换鞋，可以看的出来，这个家里，已经很久没有收拾了。

让二人在沙发上落座，秦汐给两人拿了两瓶水，阮柏云这才继续询问：“我就叫你小吴吧，不知道你们和念念什么关系，过来又有什么事情？”

吴姜思索了几秒，斟酌着怎么开口：“嗯...我也不叫什么先生、女士了，我就称呼你们阮大哥，秦姐吧。是这样的，我和芽芽昨天在水上乐园玩，晚上的时候，见到一个小女孩，站在泳池边上。”

“嗯......我学过一些东西，可以看到别人看不到的东西，你们懂吗？”

吴姜说到这里，看向了阮柏云和秦汐。

秦汐还没什么反应，阮柏云的怒气已经显现在了脸上。

没想到，一对小年轻，居然骗到了他家里来了。

因为女儿的事情，他们已经够心力交瘁的了，老婆今天的状态刚刚好点，没想到又来了两个伤口上撒盐的。

阮柏云正准备怒斥，吴姜就抢先开口了，“我没有骗你们，念念就在我这里，如果你们相信我的话，我可以让你们看到念念。”

Early the next morning, Wu Jiang and Li Yueya drove together and searched for communities with the word "Jinxiu" on the navigation system, and searched for them one by one.

Fortunately, there were only three communities with these two characters in the entire Green City, so Wu Jiang chose the nearest one and drove there.

It was daytime now and the little girl couldn't come out. Wu Jiang asked Niannian to look through the pendant. It was not here.

There are two left, one is Jinxiu Garden Community, which is an ordinary community.There is another one, Jinxiu Tianxi, which is a villa area.

Wu Jiang asked Niannian again carefully how the environment in her home community was and whether there was anything special about it.

Nian Nian's voice reached Wu Jiang's ears through the Soul Gathering Pendant, "My home is very big. There are many trees and flowers outside, and there are many fish in the water. Also, I don't need to take the elevator. I'm home as soon as I enter!"

Speaking of this, Wu Jiang immediately understood, isn't this a villa?If the little girl had said this earlier, he would have gone straight to the Splendid Seal.

After setting the navigation, the car sped away immediately.

The security at Jinxiu Tianxi is very strict. After Wu Jiang got off the bus and registered, the security guard called the owner again before letting him go.

At this moment, Ruan Boyun and Qin tide were waiting in front of the villa. They were curious about who came to visit them and could accurately call them by name.

Qin tide's eyes were still a little red and swollen, which was obviously caused by an accident at home.

Wu Jiang's car quickly drove to the front of Villa No. 9, and he immediately saw a couple waiting there. They looked to be in their thirties, but not even forty.

Wu Jiang and Li Yueya walked forward quickly and asked politely: "Hello, may I ask, are you Mr. Ruan Boyun and Ms. Qin Xi?"

"Who are you?" Ruan Boyun frowned and asked.

Wu Jiang could already hear Nian Nian calling "Mom and Dad" at this moment.

Wu Jiang got straight to the point: "Mr. Ruan, Ms. Qin, hello, we are here for Nian Nian."

When they heard the word "Nian Nian", Ruan Boyun and Qin tide's bodies stiffened suddenly, and Qin tide's tears almost fell again.

Ruan Boyun was very wary and asked, "Who are you? What is your relationship with Niannian?"

Wu Jiang introduced himself, then introduced Li Yueya to the other party, and then said: "Mr. Ruan, it's not convenient to talk in detail here. I don't know if you can go in. I'll explain to you later."

Ruan Boyun hesitated for a moment, looked at his wife again, and then said: "Please come in!"

Wu Jiang and Li Yueya were not asked to change their shoes. It could be seen that this house had not been tidied up for a long time.

After letting the two of them sit down on the sofa, Qin tide brought two bottles of water to them. Ruan Boyun then continued to ask: "I'll call you Xiao Wu. I don't know what your relationship is with Niannian. What's going on here?"

Wu Jiang thought for a few seconds and considered how to speak: "Well...I won't call you Mr. or Ms. anymore. I'll just call you Brother Ruan and Sister Qin. It's like this. Yaya and I were playing in the water park yesterday. At night, we saw a little girl standing by the swimming pool."

"Well...I've learned something. I can see things that others can't. Do you understand?"

When Wu Jiang said this, he looked at Ruan Boyun and Qin tide.

Qin tide hadn't reacted yet, but Ruan Boyun's anger had already appeared on his face.

Unexpectedly, a young couple actually tricked him into coming to his home.

They were already exhausted mentally and physically because of their daughter's affairs. My wife was just in a better state today, but they didn't expect two more people to rub salt into the wound.

Ruan Boyun was about to rebuke angrily when Wu Jiang spoke first, "I didn't lie to you. Nian Nian is here with me. If you believe me, I can let you see Nian Nian."
